summary_oneline: Add OneDriveSource to MultiQS: download a CSV/Excel file from a OneDrive drive via Microsoft Graph, mirroring SharepointSource

localization.role: reference implementation; auth, /shares, download and parsing are drive-agnostic
base contract: async fetch(), resolve_credential, resolve_masks
no change needed; registry lookup is generic
docs introspection relies on creds.get/source.get idiom

constraints.text: App-only ClientSecretCredential cannot use /me/drive; OneDrive for Business must be addressed as /users/{upn|id}/drive (or /drives/{id}, or /shares URL). Personal (consumer) OneDrive requires delegated auth.
Keep options.get('credentials') / source.get(...) idiom so generate-multiquery-docs introspection produces generated/OneDriveSource.json
Inherit SharePoint hardening: platform.version patch, 600s download timeout, stringified headers, masks, sheet_name/pd_args
Graph client setup already duplicated between SharepointSource and ToSharepoint; a third copy increases drift

claims.claim: No OneDrive support exists in the repo
Registering a class in SOURCE_REGISTRY is sufficient for MultiQS dispatch
SharepointSource's url (/shares) mode works unchanged for OneDrive for Business sharing URLs
Only the site/drive resolution block is SharePoint-specific
The existing sharepoint extra covers OneDrive deps
Docs JSON is generated by introspection, no catalog YAML needed

unknowns.question: Which OneDrive flavour: Business (app-only, per-user drive) or personal/consumer (delegated OAuth)?
Standalone class vs. extracting a shared Graph drive base from SharepointSource?
Credential default names: new ONEDRIVE_* vs reuse SHAREPOINT_*?
Single file only (parity) or also multiple files/folder?
Personal OneDrive delegated auth: how is the initial refresh token obtained (device-code CLI vs. manual) and where is the rotated token persisted (navconfig is read-only; Redis cache?)

recommended_next_command.rationale: Localization is high-confidence and the pattern is a direct mirror; the open decisions are design choices resolved in Q&A.
